mpesa.pattern: (?P<ref>[A-Z0-9]{10})\s+Confirmed\.\s*Fuliza M-PESA amount is Ksh\s*(?P<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\.\s*Access Fee charged Ksh\s*(?P<fee>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\.\s*Total Fuliza M-PESA outstanding amount is Ksh\s*(?P<outstanding>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)
mpesa.reason_template: Fuliza borrow — the money arrives and it is owed. Both sides recorded, and the access fee gathers in its own pocket so the cost of the overdraft is visible over time.
examples: ABC1234567 Confirmed. Fuliza M-PESA amount is Ksh500.00. Access Fee charged Ksh35.00. Total Fuliza M-PESA outstanding amount is Ksh535.00 due on 2/9/26.

mpesa.pattern: (?P<ref>[A-Z0-9]{10})\s+Confirmed\.\s*Fuliza M-PESA amount is Ksh\s*(?P<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\.\s*Interest charged Ksh\s*(?P<fee>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\.\s*Total Fuliza M-PESA outstanding amount is Ksh\s*(?P<outstanding>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)
mpesa.reason_template: Fuliza interest — nothing arrived, so nothing is credited. What is owed grows, and the charge joins the running cost of the overdraft.
examples: ABC1234567 Confirmed. Fuliza M-PESA amount is Ksh500.00. Interest charged Ksh10.00. Total Fuliza M-PESA outstanding amount is Ksh510.00 due on 2/9/26.

mpesa.reason_template: Fuliza repayment — the money leaves and the obligation goes with it.
examples: ABC1234567 Confirmed. Ksh200.00 from JOHN DOE to Fuliza M-PESA. Your available Fuliza M-PESA limit is Ksh1,000.00. Your M-PESA balance is 50.00.

mpesa.pattern: Dear\s+\S+,\s*your outstanding Fuliza M-PESA amount is Ksh\s*(?P<outstanding>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)
mpesa.reason_template: Fuliza statement — a reading of what is outstanding. Nothing moved, so nothing is recorded.
examples: Dear DOREEN, your outstanding Fuliza M-PESA amount is Ksh535.00 due on 2/9/26. Your available Fuliza M-PESA limit is Ksh1,000.00.

mpesa.pattern: (?P<ref>[A-Z0-9]{10})\s+Confirmed\.?\s*You have received Ksh\s*(?P<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+from\s+(?P<name>.+?)\s+on\s+(?P<date>\S+)\s+at\s+(?P<time>[\d:]+\s*[APap]\.?[Mm]\.?)\s*New business balance is Ksh\s*(?P<balance>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)
mpesa.reason_template: Into your Pochi — money in, from {counterparty}. Pochi is its own place, kept apart from the M-Pesa balance.
examples: ABC1234567 Confirmed.You have received Ksh300.00 from JANE DOE on 2/8/26 at 4:30 PM New business balance is Ksh1,200.00.

mpesa.reason_template: Out of your Pochi and into M-Pesa — your money at both ends.
examples: ABC1234567 Confirmed, Ksh500.00 has been moved from your Pochi to your M-PESA account on 2/8/26 at 4:30 PM.. New Pochi balance is Ksh700.00. New M-PESA balance is Ksh900.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

mpesa.reason_template: Out of M-Shwari — back into M-Pesa. Your money either way; nothing was earned and nothing was spent.
examples: ABC1234567 Confirmed.Ksh1,000.00 transferred from M-Shwari on 2/8/26 at 4:30 PM. M-Shwari balance is Ksh500.00 .M-PESA balance is Ksh1,500.00 .Transaction cost Ksh.0.00

mpesa.reason_template: Into M-Shwari — a savings account you hold, so this is money moving between two of your own places, not money spent.
examples: ABC1234567 Confirmed.Ksh1,000.00 transferred to M-Shwari on 2/8/26 at 4:30 PM. M-PESA balance is Ksh500.00 .New M-Shwari saving account balance is Ksh2,500.00. Transaction cost Ksh.0.00

mpesa.reason_template: Paybill payment of KES {amount:,.2f} to {counterparty} recognised, but which pocket to spend from isn't determined automatically — resolve manually.
examples: QGH7XJ4P2Q Confirmed. Ksh1,500.00 sent to SAFARICOMHOME for account 11619547 on 1/8/26 at 3:22 PM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh12,154.47. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

mpesa.reason_template: Paybill payment of KES {amount:,.2f} to {counterparty} recognised, but which pocket to spend from isn't determined automatically — resolve manually.
examples: QGH7XJ4P2Q Confirmed. Ksh450.00 paid to NAIROBI WATER for account 998877 on 2/8/26 at 4:30 PM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh12,050.00

mpesa.reason_template: Money sent of KES {amount:,.2f} to {counterparty} recognised, but which pocket to spend from isn't determined automatically — resolve manually.
examples: QGH7XJ4P2Q Confirmed. Ksh1,000.00 sent to MARY WANJIRU 254798765432 on 2/8/26 at 9:00 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh12,050.00

mpesa.reason_template: Till payment of KES {amount:,.2f} to {counterparty} recognised, but which pocket to spend from isn't determined automatically — resolve manually.
examples: QGH7XJ4P2Q Confirmed. Ksh450.00 paid to NAIVAS SUPERMARKET on 20/7/26 at 4:30 PM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh12,050.00

mpesa.reason_template: {amount} sent to {counterparty}. Which pocket is yours to decide.
examples: ABC1234567 Confirmed. Ksh150.00 sent to SAFARICOM DATA BUNDLES on 2/8/26 at 4:30 PM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh900.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

mpesa.pattern: (?P<ref>[A-Z0-9]{10})\s+Confirmed\.?\s*You have received Ksh\s*(?P<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+from\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z .'-]*?)\s*(?P<phone>[\d*][\d*\s]{2,18})?\s*on\s+(?P<date>\S+)\s+at\s+(?P<time>[\d:]+\s*[APap]\.?[Mm]\.?)\s*New M-PESA balance is Ksh\s*(?P<balance>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)
mpesa.reason_template: Money received — mapped to budget.record_income (unambiguous; income always credits liquid balance).
examples: QGH7XJ4P2Q Confirmed. You have received Ksh1,500.00 from JOHN KAMAU 254712345678 on 2/8/26 at 10:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh12,050.00
UHIE73CBRB Confirmed. You have received Ksh1,000.00 from mary ngigi on 26/8/26 at 9:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh5,000.00

mpesa.reason_template: Airtime purchase of KES {amount:,.2f} to {counterparty} recognised, but which pocket to spend from isn't determined automatically — resolve manually.
examples: QGH7XJ4P2Q confirmed. You bought Ksh50.00 of airtime on 1/8/26 at 11:15 PM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh13,654.47. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

mpesa.reason_template: Cash out — the money moved from M-Pesa into your pocket. Still yours, so it is a transfer into Cash rather than a spend.
examples: QGH7XJ4P2Q Confirmed. Ksh2,000.00 withdrawn from Agent 123456 - TOWN SHOP on 2/8/26 at 1:00 PM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh10,050.00

mpesa.reason_template: Cash out at an agent — the money moved from M-Pesa into your pocket. Still yours, so it is a transfer into Cash rather than a spend.
examples: ABC1234567 Confirmed.on 2/8/26 at 4:30 PMWithdraw Ksh1,000.00 from 123456 - SOME AGENT New M-PESA balance is Ksh500.00. Transaction cost, Ksh29.00.
ABC1234567 Confirmed. Your account balance was: M-PESA Account : Ksh1,500.00 on 2/8/26 at 4:30 PM. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

mpesa.pattern: (?:^Failed\.|Transaction failed|you do not have (?:sufficient|enough)|You have entered the wrong PIN)
mpesa.reason_template: This one did not go through. Nothing moved.
examples: Failed. Insufficient funds in your M-PESA account as well as Fuliza M-PESA to send.

kcb.reason_template: KES {amount:,.2f} moving from {from_account} to {to_account}. If both are yours this is one move between your own accounts, not a spend.
examples: SEND TO M-PESA request of KES 2,000 from 135***140 to 254***143 - BONVENTURE NGUGI MAINA has been received for processing.
SEND TO M-PESA request of KES 2,000 from 135***140 to 254***143 - BONVENTURE NGUGI MAINA has been received for processing. M-PESA REF: UHPB9480T9

kcb.provenance: reversal, recognised so netting can pair it with its charge

kcb.reason_template: Money received via KCB — mapped to budget.record_income (unambiguous; income always credits liquid balance).
examples: ABCD1234 Confirmed! You have received KES 5,000.00 from JOHN KAMAU - 1234 at 02-08-26 10:15 AM via KCB

kcb.reason_template: KCB card transaction of {currency} {amount:,.2f} to {counterparty} recognised, but which pocket to spend from isn't determined automatically — resolve manually.
examples: KES 429.00 transaction made on KCB card 1234XXXXXXXX5678 at GOOGLE *Spotify Music on 1/8/26 12:25pm, Avail balance KES 59,055.00

kcb.pattern: KCB Mobile Loan of\s+KES\s*(?P<amount>[\d,]+\.?\d*)\s+has been approved and credited.*?facility fee of\s+KES\s*(?P<fee>[\d,]+\.?\d*)\s+has been charged.*?loan balance is\s+KES\s*(?P<loan_balance>[\d,]+\.?\d*)
kcb.reason_template: KCB Mobile Loan disbursed — mapped to budget.record_income (the loan amount unambiguously credits liquid balance); a facility fee was also charged, recorded for context but not separately deducted here.
examples: KCB Mobile Loan of KES 10,000.00 has been approved and credited to your account. A facility fee of KES 250.00 has been charged. Your new loan balance is KES 10,250.00

kcb.pattern: KES\s*(?P<amount>[\d,]+\.?\d*)\s+was debited from your KCB account to repay your KCB Mobile Loan\s+(?P<loan_number>\d+).*?loan balance is\s+KES\s*(?P<loan_balance>[\d,]+\.?\d*)

kcb.pattern: KES\s*(?P<amount>[\d,]+\.?\d*)\s+was debited from your Vooma wallet to repay your Vooma Loan\s+(?P<loan_number>\d+).*?loan balance (?:is|of)\s+KES\s*(?P<loan_balance>[\d,]+\.?\d*)
